clue.text: What can reduce stinging in cut parts

parts.note: to dock is to cut short, as with a tail
leaves in the sense of departs or goes away

explanation.surface: Seems to describe a remedy for a sting on a wounded part of the body.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Parts' looks like a noun but is the verb, to depart. Dock leaves are the folk remedy rubbed on nettle stings in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubbing the broad foliage of the dock plant on nettle rash is a traditional way to soothe the stinging.

clue.text: Children's author raised boy, capturing hearts

indicators.note: capturing means the first piece holds the second inside it
in a down clue, raised means the word is written upwards, so read backwards

parts.note: a lad is a boy
H is the abbreviation for hearts in card games

explanation.surface: A writer for children brings up a boy and wins his affection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Raised' turns LAD into DAL, and 'capturing' places H within it.
explanation.definitionFit: Roald Dahl wrote Charlie and the Chocolate Factory and many other books for young readers.

clue.text: Certificate of film suitable for adults in particular

parts.note: cert is a short form of certificate
A was the old British film classification for adult audiences

explanation.surface: Reads like a description of an adult rating issued to a film.
explanation.walkthrough: The British Board of Film Classification once rated films A, meaning adults should accompany children.
explanation.definitionFit: Certain can mean particular or specific, as in a certain person.

clue.text: Greeting to old acquaintance could make someone tingle

indicators.note: could make says these letters can be rearranged to form something new

explanation.surface: Suggests meeting an old friend gives someone a thrill.
explanation.definitionFit: A jocular salutation used when meeting someone after a long absence.

clue.text: Woolly type mostly taking part of old actor

indicators.note: mostly means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: an alpaca is a woolly South American animal
in means taking part, as in being in on something

explanation.surface: A sheep-like animal seems to be playing a role alongside a veteran actor.
explanation.definitionFit: Al Pacino is the American film star of The Godfather and Scarface.

clue.text: Jane entertains one in nest

indicators.note: entertains means holds a guest within, so one piece goes inside

parts.note: Jane Eyre is the heroine of Charlotte Bronte's novel
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A woman named Jane hosts a guest at home.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyrie is the lofty nest of an eagle or other bird of prey.

clue.text: Objections about end of the cheque

indicators.note: about here means turned around, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: buts are objections, as in no ifs or buts

explanation.surface: Someone raises objections about the closing part of a cheque.
explanation.definitionFit: The counterfoil left in a chequebook after a cheque is torn out is its stub.

clue.text: Can seabird set down in abbey?

indicators.note: in a down clue, set down places the second piece beneath the first

parts.note: a tin is a can
a tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: Asks whether a seabird could land in a monastery.
explanation.definitionFit: Tintern Abbey is a ruined Cistercian monastery in the Wye Valley, Wales, celebrated by Wordsworth.

clue.text: Don't have the time to follow British battalion

indicators.note: to follow means these pieces come after the first

parts.note: to lack is not to have
a watch tells the time, and a watch is also a period of duty

explanation.surface: Someone too busy to come after a British army unit.
explanation.definitionFit: The Black Watch is a famous Scottish infantry regiment, now a battalion of the Royal Regiment of Scotland.

clue.text: Bird leading man north

parts.note: the hero is the leading man of a story

explanation.surface: A bird seems to lead a man northwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The grey heron is a tall wading bird of rivers and lakes.

clue.text: Round Arabian land I pray troublesome arsonist's failing

indicators.note: round means the outer letters surround the inner piece
troublesome suggests disorder, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: Oman is a country on the Arabian peninsula

explanation.surface: Someone praying around Arabia about an arsonist's weakness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Troublesome' scrambles I PRAY into PYRIA, which goes round OMAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Pyromania is the compulsive urge to start fires, the defining flaw of a fire-raiser.

clue.text: Man with weapon, he came running amok

indicators.note: running amok means wildly out of control, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: An armed man arrives and goes on a wild rampage.
explanation.definitionFit: A soldier who operates an automatic firearm is a man with a weapon.

clue.text: Office worker recalled trick to perform

indicators.note: to perform suggests putting on a show, so the letters are rearranged into a new act

explanation.surface: An employee remembers a conjuring trick and decides to stage it.
explanation.definitionFit: A trainee solicitor bound by articles of apprenticeship worked in a law office.

clue.text: Redirect the post to a cleaner

indicators.note: redirect means sending a different way, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An instruction to forward mail to a cleaner.
explanation.definitionFit: The paste on a toothbrush is used to clean teeth.

clue.text: Decorate soldiers, famous one not losing heart

parts.note: OR stands for other ranks, ordinary soldiers
a name is a famous person, as in a big name

indicators.note: losing heart means the middle letter is dropped

explanation.surface: An instruction to award soldiers and a celebrity who stays brave.
explanation.definitionFit: To adorn or embellish something is to ornament it.

clue.text: Contend with girl around European capital

parts.note: to vie is to contend or compete

indicators.note: around means the girl's name is turned back to front

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Competing with a young woman in some European city.
explanation.definitionFit: Austria's capital city on the Danube.

clue.text: Book is helpful to musicians

parts.note: to assist is to help

explanation.surface: A book that aids musicians.
explanation.definitionFit: Players of the bass guitar or double bass are musicians.

clue.text: Recording takes time copying

parts.note: aping is imitating or copying

explanation.surface: Making a recording is a slow business of copying.
explanation.definitionFit: Capturing sound or pictures on magnetic tape is recording.

clue.text: Like some concrete formerly poured round playing field

indicators.note: poured round means the first piece flows around the other

parts.note: past means of former times
rec, short for recreation ground, is a British term for a public playing field

explanation.surface: Concrete once laid around a sports pitch.
explanation.walkthrough: A rec is the British local recreation ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Concrete moulded into blocks or panels before being placed on site is described this way.

clue.text: Microphone picks up a joke description of the Queen?

indicators.note: picks up means takes in, so the other pieces go inside

parts.note: mic is short for microphone
a jest is a joke

explanation.surface: A microphone catches a royal joke.
explanation.definitionFit: Royalty is described as stately or regal, as in Her Majesty.

clue.text: More than one bird races to catch island rodents

indicators.note: to catch means to hold the next piece inside

parts.note: TT, the Tourist Trophy, is the motorcycle racing on the Isle of Man
mice are rodents

explanation.surface: Birds dash about trying to grab island mice.
explanation.definitionFit: Small songbirds such as tits are collectively given this old plural form.

clue.text: Ensure smart appearance to bring case to court

definitions.meaning: ironing your jacket and trousers keeps you looking smart
to pursue a legal claim or petition

explanation.surface: Getting dressed up before going to court.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both ironing one's clothes and pursuing a petition or claim.

clue.text: Relative peace finally found in Mediterranean resort

indicators.note: found in means placed inside the other piece

parts.note: Nice is a resort on the French Riviera

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: A family member finds peace on the Riviera.
explanation.definitionFit: A brother's or sister's daughter is a family relation.

clue.text: Thin as a rake

parts.note: a simile for someone very skinny, with a hint that a rake propped up tilts against a wall

explanation.definitionFit: Lacking fat and slender, like a person compared to a garden tool.

clue.text: Out of country, don't have so much to say

parts.note: to state is to say
less means a smaller amount

explanation.surface: A traveller abroad finds less to talk about.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer's two halves as 'say less', put in the reverse order in the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone without nationality belongs to no country.

clue.text: Wide-eyed, this person standing in body of church

indicators.note: standing in means placed inside the other word

parts.note: the nave is the main body of a church
I refers to the speaker or setter

explanation.surface: Someone stands awestruck inside a church.
explanation.definitionFit: Being innocent and unworldly, a person is wide-eyed or credulous.

clue.text: Fare payable at station reduced substantially

indicators.note: reduced substantially means most of the phrase is cut away, leaving a run of letters

explanation.surface: A train fare paid at the station has been heavily discounted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fare' looks like a ticket price but means food.
explanation.definitionFit: Food is fare, and eats is informal for food.

clue.text: Tropical fish uses orange in disguise

indicators.note: in disguise means the letters are rearranged to look different

explanation.surface: A tropical fish camouflages itself with orange.
explanation.definitionFit: A surgeonfish of tropical reefs, named for sharp spines like scalpels.
